thread:
marta: uploaded a draft one-pager to the drive: 'Inference Deploy Quickcard' — single-page asset for field. link: https://drive.redwood/quickcard-v1. Core sections: security bullets, SLA triggers, deploy-mode decision microflow, and a short inbound routing checklist.
leo: looks good. request: make the performance comparison very scannable. sales wants: 3 bullets (hosted / dedicated / private) with typical 99p latency and cost-per-1k tokens deltas. tiny sparkline ok.
sam: i'll pull numbers from the last perf sweep. preliminary: hosted 99p ~130ms @8k tokens, dedicated ~95ms, private (c7gx) ~110ms depending on infra. cost deltas will be rough estimates. will drop a mini-table + CSV.
jane: include a routing box for leads: "high security -> private path", "high throughput but no data residency -> dedicated", "trial / dev -> hosted". Also add exact SFDC lead path: PQL -> Solutions Eng -> AE. one line.
marta: planning a 2x2 micro-decider viz: columns = compliance needs (low/high), columns = throughput need (low/high), and a recommended deploy mode. keeps it very consumable.
leo: for the webinar: 40m benchmark + demo + 5-10m Q&A. landing page should gate the quickcard. mention we'll share a companion benchmark blog post same week.
sam: add a one-liner on graceful degradation: "Automatic fallbacks to compatible model variants and region-level routing to preserve latency SLOs."
jane: field wants 3 canned AE responses for common objections (data residency, predictable pricing, onboarding time). keep them 1-liners.
ops-bot: created tracking params: utm_campaign=inference_quickcard_2026 utm_source=webinar.
marta: copy guidance: keep language benefit-first, avoid deep infra jargon. headline options: "Pick the right inference setup for your SLAs" or "Inference deploys: secure, predictable, and cost-aware". feedback?
leo: prefer the second one. it's benefits-led. also please call out "SLA triggers" as a small checklist: monthly commit threshold, latency SLO breach, security flag.
sam: i'll attach the CSV with measured latencies and a tiny sparkline PNG to the drive by EOD.
jane: timeline: need final quickcard by Wed noon to wire into webinar sign-up and SFDC flows. i'll map the campaign once it's final.
marta: i'll finalize wording + design notes Tue evening. will keep the doc compact — one page, printable. will include CTA + webinar sign-up QR.
leo: distribution plan: blog + 2x tweets + linkedIn lead gen ad + webinar. AE enablement pack: quick objection cheat sheet + 30s pitch.
ops-bot: SFDC campaign template created: campaign id CAMPAIGN-QUICKCARD-26.
marta: added small note: keep perf table rounded and conservative. we'll say "typical" numbers and link to the full benchmark for details.
leo: great. once the asset is final I'll swap the link on the webinar slides.
notes: Action items: sam -> perf CSV + sparkline PNG by EOD; marta -> final quickcard Wed noon; jane -> SFDC wiring after final; ops-bot created tracking + campaign.
